svg.title: Yellow Black
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Photographer’s August 2018 museum visit explicitly identifies Yellow Black (1968), Louisiana. Ordinary public photo loaded after initial navigation timeout and was downloaded from the visible image element. Yellow L-shaped field wraps left and lower edges of a black upper-right parallelogram. Wall, label and cast shadow omitted. Source owner gives physical dimensions, but observed oblique outline is normalized rather than asserting an orthographic contour. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
